positions.name: CrossSiteOperationalLearning
positions.frame: how does sequential rollout sequencing leverage operational learning and skill compounding across site teams?
positions.why: Explores the secondary operational justification for sequential cutovers: enabling supervisors and staff to build cumulative execution competence from earlier cutovers rather than propagating errors in parallel.

attaches.why: Reinforces the sequential one-site-at-a-time cutover strategy with non-negotiable rota and supervisor capacity arithmetic as a hard constraint, and confirms that database replica and reference-data rules depend on a single open cutover window.
Establishes that soak duration must be preserved against schedule slippage so that operational supervisors are not double-booked during overlapping cutover fallout.
